g.title: For each request, match() returns the first route that fits the path, along with its params.
renderPage imports the matched page module and awaits getServerSideProps with params and pathname, merging the result into the props.
An unmatched path renders 404.tsx with status 404, and a failed import or throwing data function returns a plain 500 page instead of crashing the server.

react-dom/server renders the page into an HTML template. The pathname, props and page file path are written into a script tag with id __UNNEXTED_DATA__ as JSON with the less-than sign escaped, so the data cannot close the tag.
